class.name: SpineSkinEntry
class.brief_description: Describes one attachment entry in a Spine skin snapshot.
class.description: Stores the slot index, placeholder name, and attachment for an entry returned by [member SpineSkin.attachments].

method.name: get_slot_index
method.description: Returns the index of the slot containing this skin entry.

method.name: get_name
method.description: Returns the placeholder name used to look up this attachment in the skin.

method.name: get_attachment
method.description: Returns the attachment stored by this entry, or [code]null[/code] if the entry has no attachment.

members.member: The index of the slot containing this skin entry.
The placeholder name used to look up this attachment in the skin.
The attachment stored by this entry, or [code]null[/code] if the entry has no attachment.
